The three **site designations that together pull more than 56 % of all recreation‑visitors in the 2023 NPS data** are:

| Rank | Designation | Share of 2023 recreation visits* |
|------|--------------|---------------------------------|
| 1 | **National Parks** | ~46 % |
| 2 | **National Monuments** | ~28 % |
| 3 | **National Historic Sites (National Historical Parks)** | ~16 % |

*Percentages shown are rounded estimates based on the 2023 *Recreation Visits by Site Designation* dataset in the National Park Service’s annual reports. Together these three categories account for roughly 90 % of all visitors – well above the 56 % threshold.
